title.en: Which Season Is Your Imaginary Garden In?
title.zh: 你的想象花园正在哪个季节？

description.en: Choose among six garden scenes about beginning, tending, gathering and resting. Find the season your choices give this fictional garden today.
description.zh: 在六个花园场景里，选择开始、照料、收集与休整，看看今天的选择会把这座虚构花园带到哪个季节。

introduction.en: You can design this imaginary garden without buying seeds or knowing how to grow them. The seasons describe a garden story, not age, life stage or mental health. Choose the kind of attention you would enjoy giving it now.
introduction.zh: 设计这座想象花园，不必买种子或懂种植。季节描述的是花园故事，不代表年龄、人生阶段或心理健康。选你现在愿意给它的关注方式。

focus.en: How an imagined growing cycle makes room for an initial trial, repeated care and a deliberate pause.
focus.zh: 一个想象生长周期，怎样容纳初次尝试、持续照料与主动停歇。

prompt.en: An empty garden patch is yours for a season. Your first wish is…
prompt.zh: 一小块空花地交给你一季，你最先想……

label.en: Try a tiny corner with something unfamiliar.
label.zh: 在小角落试一种陌生东西。

label.en: Set up a routine for the plants already there.
label.zh: 为已有植物安排照料节奏。

label.en: Look at what the ground needs before adding more.
label.zh: 先看土地需要什么，再决定添不添。

prompt.en: A few fictional seedlings appear. What catches your attention?
prompt.zh: 几株虚构小苗冒出来，你关注……

label.en: How to keep their regular care manageable.
label.zh: 怎样让日常照料容易维持。

label.en: Which new shapes might emerge next.
label.zh: 接着可能出现哪些新形状。

label.en: Whether part of the bed should stay undisturbed.
label.zh: 是否留一部分花床不去动它。

prompt.en: The garden has one extra free afternoon. You choose…
prompt.zh: 花园多了一个空闲下午，你选……

label.en: Leave the tools down and observe what is already enough.
label.zh: 放下工具，看看已有的哪些已足够。
开始一个有标记的小尝试。

label.en: Return to a familiar task that keeps the bed going.
label.zh: 做一件熟悉的维护小事。

prompt.en: A section has grown more than you expected. You…
prompt.zh: 有一片比预想长得更多，你会……

label.en: Adjust your care plan to its actual size.
label.zh: 按实际规模调整照料计划。

label.en: Save a little space to try a different arrangement.
label.zh: 留小块空间，试另一种布局。

label.en: Reduce the next round so the garden can rest.
label.zh: 减小下一轮规模，让花园休整。

prompt.en: A garden notebook has an empty page. You write…
prompt.zh: 花园笔记留着空白页，你写……

label.en: One question for the next small trial.
label.zh: 下次小尝试想追的一个问题。

label.en: What repeated care was actually useful.
label.zh: 哪些持续照料确实有用。

label.en: What you are content to leave until later.
label.zh: 哪些事愿意安心留到以后。

label.en: Tools put away beside a bed allowed to be quiet.
label.zh: 工具收好，一块被允许安静的花床。

label.en: A new shoot with plenty of unclaimed space.
label.zh: 一株新芽，旁边还有未安排的空地。

label.en: A garden held together by small regular visits.
label.zh: 靠一趟趟小照料维持的花园。

summary.en: Your garden story begins with a small trial rather than a fully planted plot. Newness is given a little room to show what it might become. This is a season you selected in a game, not a prediction of your future.
summary.zh: 你的花园故事从一小次试种开始，不急着种满。新东西得到一点空间，慢慢显出可能。这是游戏里选出的季节，不是对未来的预测。

example.en: For a window box in the story, you might reserve one labeled corner for an unfamiliar color instead of redesigning every pot at once.
example.zh: 在故事的窗台花箱里，你可能留一个标记角落试陌生颜色，不必一次重排所有花盆。

strength.en: A small trial makes curiosity easier to act on while keeping the rest of the imagined garden available for later choices.
strength.zh: 小尝试让好奇容易行动，也让想象花园的其余空间继续留给之后选择。

tradeoff.en: New shoots still need some attention after the first exciting moment; too many experiments can make that attention difficult to give.
tradeoff.zh: 第一阵兴奋过后，新芽仍要一点关注；尝试过多时，这份关注可能难给。

experiment.en: Choose one small recreational experiment and decide what would make you want to return to it once, without committing to a whole new routine.
experiment.zh: 选一个小型休闲尝试，想想什么会让你愿意再回来一次，不必先承诺全新日程。

summary.en: Your garden has a rhythm of returning. The satisfying part is not only what appears on the first day, but how a few manageable visits keep a chosen patch going. The portrait describes your selected story rhythm rather than your reliability as a person.
summary.zh: 你的花园有一趟趟返回的节奏。满足不只在第一天出现了什么，也在几次容易维持的照料如何让一片花地继续。画像描述所选故事节奏，不评判你是否可靠。

example.en: In the fictional bed, you might keep a short note of the one repeated task that matters instead of creating an elaborate garden management system.
example.zh: 在虚构花床里，你可能只记下最需要重复的一件小事，不另建复杂的花园管理系统。

strength.en: Modest repeated attention can make a chosen activity feel familiar and approachable instead of requiring a fresh burst of motivation every time.
strength.zh: 适量的持续关注，让选定活动变得熟悉、容易靠近，不必每次都重新鼓起劲。

tradeoff.en: A routine can outlive the reason you wanted it. Returning regularly is most useful when you still have freedom to change its scale.
tradeoff.zh: 日程可能比最初想做的理由活得更久。仍可调整规模时，规律返回更容易有用。

experiment.en: Look at one enjoyable recurring activity. Keep the smallest helpful part of its routine and remove one step that has become needless work.
experiment.zh: 看看一项喜欢的重复活动。保留最小的有用日程，也去掉一项已经多余的步骤。

summary.en: Your garden ending leaves a bed quiet and the tools put away. Rest is part of this imagined cycle rather than evidence that the garden has failed. The picture leaves a future season possible without requiring you to schedule it now.
summary.zh: 你的花园结尾让花床安静，也收起工具。休整是想象周期的一部分，不证明花园失败。画面留着未来一季的可能，却不要求现在就排定它。

example.en: You might close a seasonal craft box after using it and leave a note about what remains, rather than starting the next project immediately.
example.zh: 你也许会在季节手作结束后合上材料盒，记下剩余东西，不急着马上开始下一项。

strength.en: A chosen pause can protect attention and make the activity easier to revisit because unfinished maintenance is no longer silently expanding.
strength.zh: 主动停歇能照顾注意力，也让活动更容易重访，因为未完成维护没有继续悄悄扩大。

tradeoff.en: A pause may need a practical closing step; leaving every loose end scattered can make the eventual return feel harder than it needs to.
tradeoff.zh: 停歇有时也需要实际收尾；任由所有零碎散着，可能让以后返回比必要的更难。

experiment.en: Give one optional activity a tidy stopping point: save what matters, put the tools away, and leave the next visit genuinely optional.
experiment.zh: 为一项可选活动设清楚停止点：保存有用内容、收好工具，让下一次回来真的可选。

description.en: Build a fictional growing cycle through a first trial, ongoing care or a deliberate pause. Six choices lead to spring, summer and winter garden portraits without a life-stage prediction.
description.zh: 用首个尝试、持续照顾或刻意暂停，构建虚构生长循环。六次选择读春、夏、冬画像，不预测人生阶段。

question.en: Does the winter garden mean I am falling behind?
question.zh: 冬日花园，意味着我落后了吗？

answer.en: Winter is the story's way to represent a chosen pause. Spring gives room to a first trial, and summer concerns repeated care. These are different scenes in an imagined cycle, not rankings of energy, age or personal progress.
answer.zh: 冬日是故事表示自选暂停的方式。春日留给首试，夏日关注重复照顾。它们是想象循环中的不同景，不排精力、年龄或个人进度。
